name: us-map
title: US Map
description: Animated US choropleth by state: states pop in from the centre, abbreviations appear, then the top states glow in turn.
useWhen: A value per US state needs to be shown as a map: density, sales, signups, coverage.
Two to five states should glow in turn after the map has filled in.
avoidWhen: The data is about cities or points: use us-map-bubble.
The data is movement between places: use us-map-flow.
author: HeyGen (Hyperframes)

variables.description: Headline written on with a wipe.
